|game_text='''0 side — This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time'''

Deploy a Cloud City battleground site and [Cloud City] I'm Sorry. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Admiral's Orders. During your control phase, your Lando may make a regular move. While this side up, once per turn, may ▲ Cloud City Occupation, Dark Deal, Vader's Bounty, or [Special Edition] Bespin. Flip this card if you control 3 Bespin locations and opponent controls fewer than 3 Bespin locations.

'''7 side — Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further'''

While this side up, Sense and Alter may not be played. Force drain bonuses at same site as your Lando or your Lobot may not be canceled. While Vader at a Bespin location, game text of Admiral's Orders is canceled and, if a character was just frozen, opponent loses 3 Force. If your alien/Imperial pair in battle, your total battle destiny is +2. If your Lando in battle, may target a character present with him; target is forfeit = 0. Flip this card if opponent controls more Bespin locations than you.

The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don’t Alter It Any Further”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further (V)]] (published 2 December 2025) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further]]). The two sides are printed as two slips (page 2). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC card images of 9 March 2026<ref name="ht-td-2">PC card images in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e07/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Dark/large/thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e07/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Dark/large/prayidontalteritanyfurther.gif prayidontalteritanyfurther.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6f23e07 6f23e07] (9 March 2026).</ref>, marked “E1”. What changed from the previous image: PC Tweak Set errata (both sides marked “E1”). 0 side: adds “or [Death Star II] Executor” to the deploy restriction; the download becomes “Once during your turn, may ▲ Dark Deal, Vader's Bounty, or [Special Edition] Bespin.” (was “While this side up, once per turn, may ▲ Cloud City Occupation, …”); “3 Bespin locations” is spelled “three”. 7 side: the frozen-character Force loss is removed; “If your alien/Imperial pair” becomes “While your alien/Imperial pair”; the Lando forfeit text is replaced by “Once per battle involving your Lando (twice if any Lobot also there), may add or subtract 1 from a just drawn destiny.” Text: “This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time: Deploy a Cloud City battleground site and [Cloud City] I'm Sorry. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Admiral's Orders or [Death Star II] Executor. During your control phase, your Lando may make a regular move. Once during your turn, may ▲ Dark Deal, Vader's Bounty, or [Special Edition] Bespin. Flip this card if you control three Bespin locations and opponent controls fewer than three Bespin locations. Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further: While this side up, Sense and Alter may not be played. Force drain bonuses at same site as your Lando or your Lobot may not be canceled. While Vader at a Bespin location, game text of Admiral's Orders is canceled. While your alien/Imperial pair in battle, your total battle destiny is +2. Once per battle involving your Lando (twice if any Lobot also there), may add or subtract 1 from a just drawn destiny. Flip this card if opponent controls more Bespin locations than you.”
* '''PC-E3''' ([[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further (V) (Errata 3)]]): PC card images of 8 September 2026<ref name="ht-td-3">PC card images in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c3e022f/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Dark/large/thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/c3e022f/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Dark/large/prayidontalteritanyfurther.gif prayidontalteritanyfurther.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/c3e022f c3e022f] (8 September 2026).</ref>, marked “E2”. What changed from the previous image: PC errata of September 2026 (both sides marked “E2”). 0 side: the deploy restriction adds “Endor Shield” and “[Episode I] (or [Episode VII]) cards with ability”; Lando's move is “During your deploy phase” (was “control phase”); adds “While this side up, opponent loses no Force to Cloud City Occupation or your Force drains at Bespin system.”; the download drops Vader's Bounty. 7 side: “Sense and Alter may not be played” is replaced by “… and Alter may not be played” on the Vader sentence; the Lando ability becomes “may subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny” (was “may add or subtract 1 from a just drawn destiny”). Text: “This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time: Deploy a Cloud City battleground site and [Cloud City] I'm Sorry. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Admiral's Orders, Endor Shield, [Death Star II] Executor, or [Episode I] (or [Episode VII]) cards with ability. During your deploy phase, your Lando may make a regular move. While this side up, opponent loses no Force to Cloud City Occupation or your Force drains at Bespin system. Once during your turn, may ▲ Dark Deal or [Special Edition] Bespin. Flip this card if you control three Bespin locations and opponent controls fewer than three Bespin locations. Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further: While this side up, Force drain bonuses at same site as your Lando or your Lobot may not be canceled. While Vader at a Bespin location, game text of Admiral's Orders is canceled and Alter may not be played. While your alien/Imperial pair in battle, your total battle destiny is +2. Once per battle involving your Lando (twice if any Lobot also there), may subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny. Flip this card if opponent controls more Bespin locations than you.”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata). The PC's card data (swccg-card-json) records the March 2026 text but not the September 2026 one; the text here follows the printed cards.
